نتسبسب (form IIq)
# نَتَسَبْسَبُ (natasabsabu) /na.ta.sab.sa.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَسَبْسَبَ (tasabsaba)
# نَتَسَبْسَبَ (natasabsaba) /na.ta.sab.sa.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَسَبْسَبَ (tasabsaba)
# نَتَسَبْسَبْ (natasabsab) /na.ta.sab.sab/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَسَبْسَبَ (tasabsaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
